title: Final Electric Fields
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expressions for E_x and E_y inside the waveguide.

title: Dispersion Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct dispersion relation for the waveguide modes.

title: Phase and Group Velocities
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate and show the relationships for phase velocity v_p and group velocity v_g, including v_g < c < v_p.

title: Cutoff Frequency
description: Essential Criteria: The student must demonstrate the existence of a cutoff frequency below which no wave can propagate.

title: Correctness of Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all derived quantities have the correct physical units.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common mistakes such as sign errors in the electric field components or incorrect boundary conditions.

title: Mathematical Derivations
description: Important Criteria: The student should show clear and logical mathematical derivations leading to the final results.

title: Alternative Methods
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explore alternative methods for deriving the electric fields or velocities, demonstrating deeper understanding.
